test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘SOUTH’ is written as ‘83’ and ‘CONVOY’ is written as ‘94’. How will ‘SYSTEM’ be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3cf684fc9c82a90ebdaae30f16bf56cc2b36c5a153e5a41cc8460a0e2f84635.png] The logic followed here is: Logic: Sum of the place value of all numbers = Code of the word. ‘SOUTH’ is coded as '82' ⇒ 19 + 15 + 21 + 20 + 8 = 83.
